pages.text: A clock made of genes that switch themselves off builds a rhythm with its own period. Drive it with light near that period and it locks on (entrainment); the culture works hardest in its active phase.
$(thing)Set$(): Period, Phase.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Jet lag: the rhythm varies by +/- 2%.d.
$(thing)Limits$(): none beyond the recipe windows.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A locked clock in daylight is fastest.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Entrainment: locks when |period - 24| is small$(br)Active, against noon: peaks when the active phase meets daylight
